payload.posture: Read 1 Corinthians 15:35–49 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states seed, bodies, glory, and Adam answer how the dead rise. But someone will say, “How are the dead raised?” and, “With what kind of body do they come?” As we have borne the image of those made of dust, let’s also bear the image of the heavenly. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
